caption: The drawing depicts an old-fashioned oil lamp consisting of several distinct parts. The base of the lamp is square-shaped and colored light blue, with vertical ridges and floral-like embossed patterns on its top surface. Above this base is a blue, fluted column supporting a gold-toned connector. The body of the lamp is transparent with slight greenish tones, featuring raised patterns resembling draped fabric with tassels and star-shaped designs. At the top of this section is a gold-colored burner with a round knob and openings for ventilation. Attached above the burner is a clear, tall, and cylindrical glass chimney with a flared and scalloped rim. The background is plain with a light beige or off-white color, and there is a small signature in the bottom right corner.
title: Lamp
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
